name: Mok'thardin's Enchantment
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Far Seer Mok'thardin needs a strong binding for the Stranglethorn trophies gathered so far. Aged sinew from elder primates in southern Stranglethorn Vale will hold the feathers, claws, and fang fast.

sections.title: A Magical Tether
sections.body: The feathers, claws, and pristine fang bring Far Seer Mok'thardin to the next stage of his ritual. He needs a tough magical tether to bind them together. Only aged sinew from an Elder Mistvale Gorilla can endure the magic he plans to weave.

sections.title: Hunting the Mistvale Elders
sections.body: Elder Mistvale Gorillas forage in the jungles east of Booty Bay. Mok'thardin needs flawless sinew, so you may have to hunt several before finding one fit for his enchantment.

faq.q: What is the aged gorilla sinew needed for?
aliases: what does mokthardin need the sinew for
faq.answer: Far Seer Mok'thardin needs aged sinew as a magical tether to hold the gathered feathers, claws, and pristine fang securely together for his enchantment.

faq.q: Where are the Elder Mistvale Gorillas located?
aliases: where to find elder mistvale gorilla
faq.answer: Elder Mistvale Gorillas forage in the southern jungles of Stranglethorn Vale, east of Booty Bay.
Far Seer Mok'thardin, an orc spiritual guide at Grom'gol Basecamp in Stranglethorn Vale, asks for the sinew.

faq.q: Where does this fit into Mok'thardin's enchantment work?
faq.answer: The hunt follows the gathering of the claws and pristine fang. Far Seer Mok'thardin's enchantment work continues afterward.

angles.text: As a Horde adventurer, you can seek Far Seer Mok'thardin's aid at Grom'gol Basecamp. He crafts potent jungle magic to bolster your standing in Stranglethorn Vale.
